top_signals.title: Macau Gaming Revenue Decline Extends Despite Golden Week Boost
top_signals.summary: Macau’s gaming revenue declined for a fifth straight month in October, as weak spending by high-end players offset a surge in Golden Week visitors.

top_signals.summary: Germany is set to miss its official target for filling natural gas storage sites, leaving it with a reduced buffer against surging winter demand.
